specification.problem: Simulate the ternary controlled-X (TCX) gate and the ternary controlled-Z (TCZ) gate on qutrits encoded in qubit pairs. Check their action on the valid 3^n subspace, and use TCX to build a ternary SWAP.
specification.reconstruction_scope: Smallest instance: two qutrits (a,b) on 4 qubits, with a on qubits (a0,a1) and b on qubits (b0,b1). Build TCX(a->b) and TCX(b->a) (control on level 2, target shift +1 mod 3), and the TCZ variant. Verify the permutation or phase table on the 9 valid basis states, with |11> never populated. Out of scope: full Cartan decomposition of SU(3), the physical implementation analysis, universality proofs, ternary Toffoli and Muthukrishnan-Stroud synthesis, and the general qudit extension. These are only sketched in the notes.

symbols.meaning: qubit-pair encoding of a trit, with q_1 the high bit

equations.label: Qutrit encoding
equations.description: Two-qubit encoding of a qutrit, with |11> unused.
equations.justification: The encoding is the proposed construction from the sketch, not stated in the abstract.

equations.label: TCX gate
equations.description: The target is shifted by +1 mod 3 when the control qutrit is |2>.
equations.abstract_quote: we propose the ternary controlled X (TCX) gate
equations.justification: The abstract names the gate. The control level 2 and the +1 shift are taken from the sketch convention.

equations.label: TCZ gate
equations.description: The target gets a phase omega^t when the control qutrit is |2>.
equations.justification: The abstract names the gate. The explicit form is the standard clock-gate definition.

equations.label: Qubit-level shift on the valid subspace
equations.description: On the valid subspace the control condition a=2 reduces to the single qubit a1=1. The shift is a controlled permutation of the target pair, leaving |11> fixed.
equations.justification: Proposed decomposition from the sketch. Possible gate sequence: CCX(a1,b0,b1) first, which maps 01 to 11. Then CX(a1,b0) toggles b0, giving 11->10 and 00->01, but this also moves 10->11, so a further fix-up is needed. The exact sequence must be checked by simulation on the 9 valid states.
assumptions: Exact sequence to be verified by simulation

equations.label: Ternary SWAP from TCX
equations.description: Target action of the ternary SWAP, to be built from TCX-type gates and shift conjugations. The exact count and arrangement are not given by the abstract and must be searched or verified by simulation.
equations.justification: The abstract says the synthesis of the ternary SWAP is investigated. The construction is assumed from the sketch.
assumptions: The construction is verified by simulation

registers.name: a
registers.role: Control qutrit (a0 low bit, a1 high bit)

registers.name: b
registers.role: Target qutrit (b0 low bit, b1 high bit)

specification.initial_state: Each of the 9 valid basis states |a,b> with a,b in {0,1,2}, prepared with X gates, in turn. |11> is never populated.

steps.description: Prepare a valid basis state by applying X to the appropriate qubits, following the encoding of eq_1.
Apply the TCX construction on the 4 qubits (or TCZ, built from controlled phases).
Optionally compose the TCX gates, with shift conjugations, to realize the ternary SWAP.
Read the statevector (no measurements) and compare with the expected permutation or phase table.

specification.measurement: If counts are required, measure all 4 qubits and decode with Qiskit little-endian order: for the key string s=bits[::-1], a0=s[0], a1=s[1], b0=s[2], b1=s[3]. For statevector or unitary tasks, apply no measurements.
specification.classical_postprocessing: Decode each qubit pair to a trit with t=2*q1+q0 and reject any outcome with pair 11. Compare the output trit pairs with the target table.
assumptions: The scope is a 2-qutrit instance on 4 qubits, chosen by the researcher
TCX uses control level 2 and shift +1
Qubit simulation stands in for qutrit hardware
Gate counts are taken after unrolling to u and cx
